Implemented on branch worktree-agent-a3b79c80f013d24d0 (5 commits on e891562; now being rebased onto main 5e1b10f). Indexed target lookups (TargetPositions), clip shortcuts with full computation kept as oracle, HostInput no longer rebuilds an identity map per pointer event, part picking builds only part targets, keyboard nearest is a min. Incremental overlay: standing-selection layer cached and reused across hover/focus/linked frames; emphasis copy parsed once per view; emphasisMarkup lazy. Not incremental (documented): re-windowing, setTargetStyles, update, selection-layer recompute, eager SVG render for Canvas.
Measurements (M3 Max, Chromium 151, fastLinkJS, median of 3, 40fe101 vs e891562): pointer-to-highlight svg10k 57 -> 4.6 ms, canvas100k 198 -> 6.7 ms; view compile svg10k 1790 -> 375 ms, canvas100k 9496 -> 3455 ms; re-window 1814 -> 332 / 9382 -> 3071 ms; retained heap 70 -> 51 / 764 -> 577 MiB; disposal 0 listeners/roots, 0/5 disposed widgets survive GC.
Gate: performance/browser-budgets.json + tools/check-performance-browser.cjs (2x/+5 ms time, 1.15x+2 MiB heap). At 29b5fa2: 44/44 budgets ok, exit 0; negative control at e891562 exit 1. testAll 2206 tests, compat, links, browser suites 13/13 at pre-rebase SHA. IndexedPickingScaleSuite (JVM+JS) checks indexed queries against exhaustive oracles on 10,000 targets.
Pending: JVM timing receipt performance/timings/v1.tsv not regenerated; one machine/browser only; budgets apply to fastLinkJS (fullLinkJS hang filed separately).
